customers_say: Customers find the door lock easy to install, with one noting it fits perfectly on wooden door frames, and appreciate its reliable performance and triple deadlocks for high security. The lock offers multiple unlocking options, adds a modern touch to the door, and provides unparalleled convenience for the whole family. While the build quality and appearance receive positive feedback, customers have mixed opinions about the user experience.

reviews.author: Asit kumar Subudhi
reviews.title: Thank you UC and Amazon for this amazing Door lock.
reviews.body: A must buy product. Fully satisfied. Easy to install and use. Provides full security to your entry and also easyvto control the access through app. A value for money product. A little bit desatisfied with the delay in installation bur rest okay.

reviews.author: Amazon Customer
reviews.title: Professional technician
reviews.body: Great experience with the Urban Company Native lock installation. The technician was extremely professional, skilled, and handled the door fitting with neat precision. He also took the time to explain how the smart lock functions, set up the app, and cleared all the drilling mess after finishing the job. 5/5 stars!

reviews.author: akash kahalkar
reviews.title: great lock with enhancment to make.
reviews.body: good lock with great features, only drawback is less integration with pre installed door bells, it come with bellLink device but that only support old analog door bells not digital ones. in terms of battery it uses Duracell Aa. would have been better if they have provided rechargable battery.

reviews.title: Good solid lock
